variables.ITEM_DESCRIPTION:
A new scenario that unifies multiple video recording and generation technologies into a single AI-driven pipeline, enabling marketing agents (and other scenarios) to automatically produce professional video content.

## Problem Statement
Vrooli's marketing crew currently produces only text-based content (tweet threads, blog posts, feature announcements). Video content is far more engaging for product demos, tutorials, and promotional material, but there is no unified tool for creating it. Meanwhile, Vrooli already has two video recording capabilities scattered across different scenarios (Browser Automation Studio and Scenario-to-Desktop) that are tightly coupled to their specific use cases and not reusable for general video production.

## Vision
Video Studio becomes a permanent capability in Vrooli's recursive improvement loop. Every scenario we build can have automated marketing videos generated for it. Marketing agents get a single interface to request videos regardless of the underlying recording technology. The system literally markets itself.

## Core Use Cases
1. **Product demo videos** — Automatically record a web app walkthrough for a new or updated scenario, with narration/annotations
2. **Feature announcement clips** — Short promotional videos highlighting new capabilities, suitable for social media
3. **Tutorial/onboarding videos** — Step-by-step guides showing how to use Vrooli scenarios
4. **Desktop application demos** — Record multi-window desktop workflows for scenarios that go beyond the browser
5. **Composite marketing videos** — Combine motion graphics intro + live demo recording + outro into polished final output

## Phased Requirements

### P0 — Core Recording Capabilities
- **Browser recording via BAS dependency**: Integrate Browser Automation Studio as a scenario dependency. BAS already has Playwright-based browser viewport recording with WebM/MP4/GIF output and a full artifact/export pipeline. Video Studio should be able to request 'record this web app doing X' and get back a video file.
- **Custom desktop screen recording**: Implement fresh (NOT as a dependency on Scenario-to-Desktop). Scenario-to-Desktop's recording is tightly coupled to its smoke test pipeline — it records a fixed flow and checks for failures. Video Studio needs fundamentally different capabilities: story structure, scene sequencing, timing control, multiple takes, and scripted narratives. Re-implement the FFmpeg + Xvfb core (which is straightforward) with a clean API designed for creative video production rather than testing.
- **AI-driven scripting**: An agent takes a video brief (text description of what the video should show) and produces a recording script — what to click, what to type, what to highlight, scene transitions, timing.
- **FFmpeg compositing**: Stitch together segments from different recording sources, add transitions, adjust timing.

### P1 — Polish & Integration
- **Marketing crew integration**: The marketing-crew team's content-creator already has updated instructions to log video opportunities. Video Studio should expose an API/CLI that the marketing workflow can invoke: content-creator writes a video brief → Video Studio produces the video → content-editor reviews.
- **Platform-specific output formats**: Landscape (YouTube/website), square (Instagram), vertical (TikTok/Reels), with appropriate resolution and compression.
- **Narration/annotation overlay**: Text overlays, callouts, and potentially TTS narration on top of recorded footage.
- **Template system**: Reusable video templates for common patterns (feature demo, tutorial, announcement) so agents don't start from scratch each time.

### P2 — Advanced Motion Graphics
- **Programmatic motion graphics**: Evaluate and integrate a tool like Remotion (React-based programmatic video framework) or Rendervid (free/open-source alternative). These enable AI agents to generate intros, outros, explainer animations, data visualizations, and other motion graphics from text prompts. Remotion has mature Claude Code integration via 'Agent Skills' (28+ rule files). Rendervid is permissive-licensed and designed for AI agent operation. Don't hard-commit to a specific tool yet — evaluate when we get here.
- **Composite pipeline**: Full marketing video assembly — motion graphics intro → live demo recording → motion graphics outro, all automated.
- **Brand consistency**: Consistent color schemes, fonts, logo placement across all generated videos.

## Existing Infrastructure to Leverage
- **Browser Automation Studio (BAS)**: Playwright recordVideo + FFmpeg post-processing. Already has artifact/export pipeline. Would be used as a scenario dependency for browser recording.
- **Scenario-to-Desktop**: Has FFmpeg + Xvfb desktop recording at 1920x1080/15fps. The recording technology (not the scenario itself) can inform Video Studio's desktop recording implementation.
- **FFmpeg resource**: Already available as a Vrooli resource for video encoding/compositing.
- **Agent-Manager**: For spawning AI agents that script and orchestrate video creation.
- **Marketing Crew (prompt-manager)**: Already updated with awareness of planned Video Studio capability. Content-creator will log video opportunities as demand signals.

## Architecture Notes
- Video Studio should be a standard Vrooli scenario with API + CLI + UI
- BAS is a scenario dependency (for browser recording)
- Desktop recording is built-in (custom implementation using FFmpeg + Xvfb)
- Motion graphics tooling (P2) would likely be an additional dependency or embedded library
- The API should expose high-level operations: 'create video from brief', 'record browser session', 'record desktop session', 'composite segments', 'render motion graphic'
- Consider whether the UI needs a preview/editing capability or if it's purely agent-driven with human review of final output

## Success Criteria
- An agent can take a text brief describing a desired marketing video and produce a finished video file without human intervention (human reviews output, not process)
- Browser-based demos are recorded cleanly at target resolution with no artifacts
- Desktop recordings support scripted multi-step workflows with scene control
- Output formats cover major social media platforms
- The marketing crew can request videos through their existing workflow
- Video production time is measured in minutes, not hours

# Initialize: Bootstrap Backlog Item

## Purpose

Bootstrap a new backlog item with a solid foundation in one agent pass: clarifying questions, suggestions, a refined summary, and (for idea/execute kinds) PRD + requirements generation via prd-control-tower.

## Input Context

**Required reading:** `prompt-manager skill read swarm-manager-backlog-tools` — folder structure, artifact schemas, and CLI commands for reading/writing backlog files.

**Required reading:** `prompt-manager skill read swarm-manager-processing-guidance` — processing patterns and quality standards.

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Reading all existing item context (spec, archive, any user-added files)
- Generating clarifying questions (3–5, pre-answered where inferable from context)
- Generating suggestions (2–3 high-impact improvements)
- Producing a refined summary (`enhance/summary.md`)
- For idea/execute kinds: generating PRD context and invoking prd-control-tower
- Preserving any existing artifacts on re-run (fill gaps, don't overwrite)

**Out of scope:**
- Processing/implementing the item (see `swarm-manager-process-*` skills)
- Modifying `archive/` — it contains user-provided materials and must not be altered by agents
- Queueing the item for execution

## Output Requirements

All writes via CLI using `--stdin` with a heredoc (avoids shell quoting issues):

```bash
swarm-manager backlog file-upload --kind idea --name video-studio --path <path> --stdin <<'EOF'
<content>
EOF
```

   ```bash
     ],

   }
   ```


4. **Generate refined summary** (`enhance/summary.md`)

   Synthesize all context into a structured plan:
   - **idea/execute**: Vision, scope, architecture outline, key decisions, next steps
   - **fix**: Problem statement, reproduction steps, root cause analysis, proposed fix, verification plan
   - **research**: Research question, methodology, data sources, expected deliverables, timeline

   ```bash
   swarm-manager backlog file-upload --kind idea --name video-studio --path enhance/summary.md --stdin <<'EOF'

   ```

### Re-run Handling

```
Do any initialize artifacts already exist?
  → No  → Generate everything fresh
  → Yes → Read existing artifacts
          Preserve all existing answers and decisions

```

- **Don't** skip reading context before generating — existing materials may answer your questions

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| `file-get` returns 404 | Normal on first run — generate fresh content |
| `file-upload` fails | Check kind and name match: `swarm-manager backlog get --kind <kind> --name <name>` |
| prd-control-tower not available | Skip PRD generation, note in summary.md |
| Archive already contains detailed PRD | Use it as context, don't regenerate — focus on gaps |
| Item has rich description | Pre-answer questions where possible, generate fewer |
